key.name: history-size
key.summary: Number of items to keep in history
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard items to store in history (1-500). Older items are deleted.

key.name: use-primary-selection
key.description: Also track the primary (mouse) selection in addition to the clipboard

key.name: sync-selections
key.description: Keep clipboard and primary selection synchronized

key.name: save-images
key.description: Save copied images to clipboard history

key.name: save-files
key.description: Save copied file paths to clipboard history

key.name: keep-content
key.description: Restore clipboard content when the source application closes

key.name: show-preview
key.description: Show thumbnail previews for images in the history

key.name: confirm-clear
key.description: Ask for confirmation before clearing the entire history

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: Automatically paste when selecting an item from history (X11 only)

key.name: exclude-pattern
key.description: Regular expression pattern for text to exclude from history

key.name: popup-position
key.summary: Where the keyboard shortcut opens the history
key.description: "pointer" opens the history dialog at the mouse pointer, "applet" next to the panel applet. Wayland always uses "applet".

key.name: persist-history
key.description: Keep the history in an encrypted database whose key is stored in the login keyring. When false, history is kept in memory only.
